references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5071155760332800, the css-pseudo-4 selectorText anchor and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite of 10 assertions (typeof + script) mirrors the spec sentence; 1 pass / 9 fail on Chromium 153 — every behavioural probe can fail.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the probe and the primary action, with native vs honest-unsupported labels.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for text/background; black-on-ivory/stone and ivory-on-black pairs meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, labels, polite status regions, visible focus; accessibility tree not inspected with DevTools MCP.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; no horizontal page overflow, 44px targets, wide tables scroll inside labelled regions.

spec_match.rationale: Collects ::view-transition-group CSSPseudoElement objects in transition.ready and compares type vs selectorText; uses selectorText as animate() pseudoElement.

interactive.rationale: Spotlight radio + shuffle button run a real startViewTransition each time and rebuild the table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Same type ×3, distinct selectorText, object-driven spotlight and the unescaped KeyframeEffect.pseudoElement gotcha are all shown.

edge_cases.rationale: Escaped name \31 st-pick; KeyframeEffect.pseudoElement reports unescaped 1st-pick which pseudo() rejects (verified null).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 153: three shuffles desktop+mobile, table showed 1 distinct type, effect string for 1st-pick re-selected null, fallback spotlight dimmed the other two groups and was labelled FALLBACK. Console clean.

openQuestions.title: Capture the native selectorText path on a build that has the attribute
openQuestions.detail: Chrome for Testing 153 (the only browser here) lacks CSSPseudoElement.selectorText even with --enable-blink-features=CSSPseudoElementSelectorText, so only the labelled fallback branch executed. Re-run on Canary ≥160 (or with the flag on a build that has the IDL) and confirm the native rows and telemetry asserts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this environment (project rule 7b); verification used headless Chrome via Playwright plus screenshots, not DevTools MCP.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status announcements for dynamic results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic native controls with accessible names and announce dynamic result text through a polite status region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native buttons/radios/selects with visible labels; every readout is role=status aria-live=polite; 3px focus-visible outlines.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive code output wrapping no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid/flex wrapping and contain wide content in a scrollable keyboard-reachable region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: auto-fit minmax(min(100%,…)) grids, pre-wrap readouts with overflow-wrap:anywhere, tables in tabindex=0 role=region wrappers.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chrome-platform-showcase/654081b3-9e1a-5f02-a6f0-8cd1f1e41633/scratchpad/r5071/shots/mobile-*.png; scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360x740 on every page

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive code output wrapping no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable on small screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons/labels min-height 44px; generated ::before/::after targets sized ≥2.75rem so they can be tapped.

guidanceConsulted.query: view transitions animate named group pseudo-elements with JavaScript
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap DOM updates in document.startViewTransition and give each persisting element a unique view-transition-name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each card has a unique view-transition-name; DOM change happens inside the update callback; work happens after transition.ready.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Respect reduced motion by adjusting animation parameters case by case rather than globally zeroing durations.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the page uses opacity-only keyframes / shorter durations / instant scrolling.

summary: Advanced composition verified with a real view transition on Chromium 153; fallback spotlight explicitly labelled as not reading from the objects.
